title: The Founding Business mark stays Frequency's pastel pill on a Space that picked its own brand color
detail: Daniel's screenshot of House of Fates (2026-10-19): the Founding badge was solid purple. A Space's chosen accent (SCAN-979) re-binds --fq-pa on the page, and the mark read --fq-pa, so it took the Space's color. The mark now reads --fq-pa-brand, bound once on the root to Frequency's own pill, so it stays pastel with ink type on every Space. The Space's own accent still colors its buttons, active tab and in-body highlights by design. No migration.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const t=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency.css','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/space-page.css','utf8');if(!t.includes('--fq-pa-brand: var(--fq-pa)'))bad.push('no fixed Frequency pill token');if(!c.includes('background:var(--fq-pa-brand'))bad.push('Founding mark can be recolored by a Space accent');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1110: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Founding mark goes back to the re-bindable --fq-pa.
